title: Descent frames for associated homogeneous vector bundles
statement: Let $F$ be a field [def-weil-field], $G,H$ group schemes over $F$ [def-sc-group-scheme], $i:H\to G$ a homomorphism, and $q:G\to Q$ an $F$-morphism. Let $r:H\to\operatorname{GL}_n$ be a rational representation on $F^n$, including $n=0$. For an $\mathcal O_Q$-module $E$ [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], a frame $\theta:q^*E\simeq\mathcal O_G^n$ uses ordinary module pullback [def-pc-module-pullback]. Its restriction along any $g:S\to G$ is the canonical composite $(qg)^*E\simeq g^*q^*E\simeq g^*\mathcal O_G^n\simeq\mathcal O_S^n$. For a commutative $F$-algebra $A$ and $g\in G(A)$, write $[g,v]_\theta$ for the section of $(qg)^*E$ corresponding to $v\in A^n$. The predicate $\operatorname{IsDescentFrame}(\theta,r)$ says that, for every such $A$, $g\in G(A)$, $h\in H(A)$ and $v\in A^n$, $q(gi(h))=q(g)$ and the sections $[gi(h),v]_\theta$ and $[g,r(h)v]_\theta$ are equal after transport along $q(gi(h))=q(g)$. When $q$ is a represented right $H$-torsor, this is precisely the descent datum $(g,w)\cdot h=(gi(h),r(h)^{-1}w)$, so $E$ with this frame is the sheaf of sections of the associated vector bundle. All test algebras, including nonreduced ones, are included. The finite free sheaf, restricted frame and framed vector are the indicated real constructions, with no descended sheaf chosen from a mere existence claim.

This is stable pointed-curve extension, not stable modification of a specified target pair. Moduli prerequisite: projective compactification with prime-to-characteristic level structure and its universal stable family, used before taking the closure of a generic lift. Projectivity of the unpointed stable coarse moduli scheme. Supporting input: Projective geometric quotients of closed stable loci for PGL. Affine-chart proof of the projective PGL quotient: Power lifting and finite generation for PGL invariants. Supporting argument: Haboush symmetric-power lifting for a trivial quotient representation. Supporting representation-theoretic input: Steinberg endomorphisms detect a nonzero fixed vector. Supporting Self-duality of rho section modules at characteristic-dependent weights. Supporting input: Positive-characteristic simplicity step, using irreducibility of the Steinberg induced module rather than assuming self-duality. Numerical input to the dimension comparison: Weyl dimension of the induced module. Supporting Kempf vanishing for dominant flag line bundles. Characteristic-zero Kodaira argument: omega_Q=M_(-2rho). Supporting smooth homogeneous quotient cotangent representation, before taking its top wedge. Definition of the associated vector bundle by its specified trivialization and descent relation, used in proof steps 4--6.
